title: pinus sylvestris var. kochiana
intro: Pinus sylvestris var. kochiana, commonly known as Siberian Pine, is a variant of the Siberian Pine plant species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Siberian Pine include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Siberian Pine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as immunomodulation, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities.
